Amazon also extended mobile connectivity to Vodafone, Apple, and the DP World Tour.  Finally, the document highlights new customer agreements with Delta Air Lines, Vodafone, and the DP World Tour, demonstrating Amazon’s strategic diversification.  Total revenue from AWS increased by approximately 22% year-over-year, reflecting the continued strength of this critical business segment.
